name: [UPD🐰] Predict the Shot
desc:
🎯 Sit across from your opponent at the table!

🔫 Reload your gun, 🛡️ block their shot, 
or fire when they least expect it!

🧠 Read your opponent's next move — 
one wrong prediction and you LOSE!

⚡ The ultimate 1v1 prediction & strategy game
First to outsmart their opponent wins!

👍 Like & Join the group!
